repairs.action: Added a TTM period-alignment paragraph to rationales.peers. It states each peer's TTM end date (NVDA 2026-07-26, AVGO 2026-08-02, MRVL 2026-08-01, INTC 2026-09-26) against AMD's 2026-09-26 TTM, with the dates verified in snapshot/peers.json. It says the roughly two-month lag for the fast-growing NVDA/AVGO/MRVL inflates their EV/Sales, so the median multiple and the relative leg are biased upward (rough estimate several percent up to about 10%, analyst judgment). The multiple is not adjusted. All numeric inputs are unchanged.
